newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says confident of IMF exit by June.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says confident of IMF exit by June.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos said he remained confident the country would be out of International Monetary Fund (IMF) supervision by June this year even if passage of a critical tax measure is uncertain.
The IMF has been supervising a series of fiscal and structural reforms of the Philippines for more than two decades.
"We are being given all the encouragement and high marks from the IMF," Ramos told a news conference.
The government has not yet attained congressional approval on one last piece of tax reform which seeks to restructure the individual and corporate income tax system to expand its revenue base.
"We will exert our best efforts...and I'm assured on the part of the Congress (it will) put it through," he added.
The Philippine Congress is currently in recess but will meet for 10 days starting in late April.
